razonamiento: The visual diagram and narration describe a multi-account Amazon Macie discovery and monitoring architecture. The central AWS account contains Amazon Macie, a central S3 bucket for findings/inventory, Amazon Athena for querying, MySQL for long-term storage, AWS Glue, and Amazon QuickSight accessed by Security Engineers. Member accounts contain Amazon Macie scanning local Amazon S3 buckets. All drawn boxes and spoken services are preserved. Athena queries the central S3 bucket and sends data to the MySQL data lake, while QuickSight queries Athena. Member Macie instances inventory S3 buckets across accounts as narrated.
nombre: Multi-Account Data Discovery and Security Reporting with Amazon Macie
